headline: Freight is the only workable agent; source stock, tooling and anodizing through conventional distributors.
ask: 25 blanks of 6061-T6 aluminum, at least 4.88 x 3.31 x 1.10 in (e.g. 1.125 in thick x 3.50 in wide flat bar, cut to 5.00 in lengths)

metrics.baseline_note: ESTIMATE: buyer googles 3-5 vendors per need, reads sites, fills RFQ/web forms; excludes waiting for replies.

rows.ask: 25 blanks of 6061-T6 aluminum, at least 4.88 x 3.31 x 1.10 in (e.g. 1.125 in thick x 3.50 in wide flat bar, cut to 5.00 in lengths)
rows.next_step: Phone or web-order 1.125x3.50 6061-T6 flat bar, cut to 5.00 in, from a local metals service center, Online Metals or McMaster.

rows.ask: Cutters for SM-101: T1 D50. FACE MILL 5FL FLUTE LEN 6.; T2 D10. FLAT END MILL 3FL FLUTE LEN 25.; T3 D6. FLAT END MILL 3FL FLUTE LEN 16.; T4 D10. SPOT DRILL FLUTE LEN 12.; T5 D6.6 DRILL FLUTE LEN 40.; T6 D8. DRILL FLUTE LEN 40.
rows.next_step: Check the crib first, then order missing cutters from MSC, McMaster, Harvey/Helical or a local tooling distributor.

rows.ask: anodize / finish as specified on the drawing for 25 x SM-101 in 6061-T6 aluminum
rows.next_step: Confirm the drawing finish callout (e.g. MIL-A-8625 Type II, color), then get quotes from 2-3 local anodizers for a 25-piece lot.

rows.ask: Backup CNC capacity: quote 25 x SM-101 from the STEP if our machine is booked
rows.next_step: Only if our machine is booked: send the STEP RFQ to Xometry, Protolabs or local job shops; use Costable as a sanity check after correcting material.

rows.ask: Inbound freight for the bar stock (~43.4 lb) from a metals service center to the shop
rows.next_step: After picking the bar supplier, compare their shipping or will-call against an SMKlog quote using the real origin ZIP and box dims.

gaps: No candidate reaches a commodity metals service center for 6061-T6 flat bar.
No usable industrial tooling distributor agent; the Amazon tool returned 401 and is a consumer channel.

Overflow candidates are aerospace-scale suppliers; no small-lot job shop agent with STEP upload.
Costable material cost ($0.38) conflicts with a ~1.7 lb blank; the estimate is unreliable until corrected.
